jutsu.name: Lunging Strike
jutsu.description: An attack with reach behind it.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user springs across the gap with a burst of chakra in their legs and thrusts a driving attack into %target. The lunge closes the distance in a single heartbeat.

jutsu.name: Sundering Blow
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S44. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user brings a sundering blow down on %target with chakra packed behind it. The strike lands with enough force to split a wooden gate.

jutsu.name: Opening Strike
jutsu.description: A hit that leaves the target exposed.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user probes %target's guard with a precise strike to the ribs. The blow finds a gap and leaves them exposed to the attacks that follow.

jutsu.name: Fighter's Poise
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B37. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user settles into a compact stance, knees bent and weight centered, wasting no motion. Their strikes grow sharper and their guard steadier for a short time.

jutsu.name: Second Wind
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S35. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws on a last reserve of chakra deep in the belly and breathes it out through their body. Their wounds begin to close and their footing steadies.

jutsu.name: Twin Kunai
jutsu.description: Two quick projectiles in succession.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user snaps two kunai from their sleeves and releases them in a single motion. They fly side by side and strike %target almost as one.

jutsu.name: Venom Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S29. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user slashes %target with a blade wet with poison. The venom seeps into their blood, burning away health, chakra and stamina as it spreads.

jutsu.name: Numbing Senbon
jutsu.description: A shot that briefly staggers.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user flicks a senbon needle, its tip glinting, into a nerve point on %target. The strike can lock their muscles for a moment and leave them staggered.

jutsu.name: Shuriken Storm
jutsu.description: A stream of light projectiles.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user fans a handful of shuriken between their fingers and loosens them in rapid succession. They whistle past %target's guard from every angle and leave deep cuts that keep bleeding.

jutsu.name: Minor Overflow
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B38. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user coaxes a small surplus of chakra into their muscles. For a few moments their strikes carry more weight and their movements come quicker.

jutsu.name: Opening Strike
jutsu.description: A hit that leaves the target exposed.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user probes %target's guard with a precise strike to the ribs. The blow finds a gap and leaves them exposed to the attacks that follow.

jutsu.name: Hushed Hours
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B21. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user slows their breathing to the stillness of the hour before dawn and gathers chakra close around them. Blows that land are drawn in and turned into vitality while their next attacks gain an edge.

jutsu.name: Venom Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S29. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user slashes %target with a blade wet with poison. The venom seeps into their blood, burning away health, chakra and stamina as it spreads.

jutsu.name: Enervating Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S28. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user strikes a chakra point on %target with two stiff fingers. Strength drains from their limbs, leaving every technique weaker until it recovers.

jutsu.name: Piercing Judgment
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B33. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user condenses lightning into a slender needle of chakra and drives it straight through %target's defenses. The puncture leaves them exposed to the next assault.

jutsu.name: Bedrock Breaker
jutsu.description: Shared pool record EE02. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user slams both palms down, and the ground beneath %target splits and buckles. Stone surges up around their legs, staggering them and pinning their feet in place.

jutsu.name: Folding Screen Guard
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B22. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user folds chakra into overlapping panels like a byobu screen and draws them close around their body. Incoming blows are softened, and part of their force is drawn back in as vitality.

jutsu.name: Backlash Palm
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B28. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user slams a chakra-charged palm into %target, infusing them with unstable energy that lashes back whenever they deal damage. The mark pulses beneath their skin, waiting for them to strike.

jutsu.name: Heavy Strike
jutsu.description: A committed, full-weight blow.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user plants their feet, twists from the hips, and puts their whole weight behind one heavy strike. It lands on %target with a crack that echoes across the field.

jutsu.name: Braced Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B26. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user drives a guarded blow into %target, keeping their stance low and their elbows tight. Chakra hardens along their arms to blunt whatever answer comes back.

jutsu.name: Withering Weave
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B36. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user threads a wasting current of chakra through %target like a needle through silk. The weave wounds them, softens their defenses, and slows their recovery.

jutsu.name: Surging Overflow
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B20. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user opens the gates of their chakra and lets it flow freely through their body. Power floods their limbs, sharpening their strikes and strengthening every movement.

jutsu.name: Cleaving Line
jutsu.description: Shared pool record A1. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws their ninjato in one flat stroke, and a thin blade of chakra peels from the edge and races down the line toward %target. Anything standing in its path is cut clean through the guard.

jutsu.name: Venom Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S29. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user slashes %target with a blade wet with poison. The venom seeps into their blood, burning away health, chakra and stamina as it spreads.

jutsu.name: Second Wind
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S35. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws on a last reserve of chakra deep in the belly and breathes it out through their body. Their wounds begin to close and their footing steadies.

jutsu.name: Weakening Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S27. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user lands a precise blow on %target's sword arm, numbing it to the shoulder. Their attacks lose their force for a short time.

jutsu.name: Reaping Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B35. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user swings through %target in a reaping arc and draws the spent chakra back along the blade. The stolen strength closes some of their own wounds.

jutsu.name: Warding Stance
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S36. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user takes a disciplined guard and wraps themselves in a tight weave of chakra. For a time, curses and weakening techniques slide off them like rain off oiled paper.

jutsu.name: Explosive Tag Cataclysm
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B14. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user flings a sheaf of explosive tags toward %target and ignites them with a single surge of chakra. The tags wrap around %target and detonate together in one deafening blast.

jutsu.name: Piercing Judgment
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B33. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user condenses lightning into a slender needle of chakra and drives it straight through %target's defenses. The puncture leaves them exposed to the next assault.

jutsu.name: Warrior's Poise
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B19. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user plants their feet and settles their breathing, drawing chakra evenly through every limb. Their strikes come sharper and their guard stands firmer, the poise of a seasoned swordsman.

jutsu.name: Suppressing Roar
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B30. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws a deep breath and releases a roar laced with chakra that shakes paper from the shoji. %target and everyone beside them are staggered, their attacks weakened by the force of it.
